summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: pad,button,usb. Software: Ableton Live,generic MIDI.
identityNotes: Research seed; Launchpad Pro MK3: USB-C MIDI controller with no built-in audio interface. MIDI In, Out 1 and Out 2/Thru use TRS minijacks with supplied TRS-to-DIN adapters. USB identifiers, class compliance, firmware/OS compatibility and physical performance remain unverified.

tests.title: Pad trigger and LED coverage
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check Launchpad Pro MK3 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all pad controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.

tests.title: Firmware and software compatibility
steps: Inspect device model and installed firmware.
Check exact model's official support page for updates and compatible software.
Record version, OS, source and date.

tests.title: Pad velocity and pressure sensitivity
steps: Enable mode exposing per-pad velocity and pressure.
Strike all 64 pads at soft, medium and hard dynamics and hold pressure.
Record event continuity, range and consistency, without enforcing arbitrary force-to-velocity thresholds.

tests.title: Standalone sequencer four-track pattern integrity
steps: Create a short reference pattern on each of four sequencer tracks.
Check 32-step playback, transport, mutation and probability settings.
Capture MIDI output and timing while no computer host is required for standalone control.

tests.title: Published custom-mode CC groups
steps: Use Custom 1 and verify eight virtual faders map to CC 7 through 14.
Use Custom 2 and verify eight virtual faders map to CC 15 through 22.
Verify Programmer Mode and LED feedback with official implementation chart before using exact note/LED assertions.
